## PR title

<!-- Your PR title must follow Conventional Commits. It becomes the squash-merge commit message and is parsed by release-please.

Valid prefixes: feat, fix, docs, ci, build, chore, perf, refactor, revert, style, test
Examples:
  feat: add custom aggregation strategy support
  fix: prevent duplicate LLM calls on pipeline retry
  docs: update client examples for new providers
  feat!: rename run() to execute() (BREAKING CHANGE)

Release impact:
  feat: → minor version bump
  fix:  → patch version bump
  feat! / BREAKING CHANGE: → major version bump
  Everything else → no release
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format
- [ ] Changes are tested (unit tests, manual verification, or both)
- [ ] Documentation updated if user-facing behavior changed
